_comment: Read by sweep_watch.py. Deterministic rules only; no model is involved.
_analyst_note: Surya 2026-10-23: no analyst or analytics roles beyond data analytics. A title naming analyst, analytics or analysis without data or software engineering (business, portfolio, security, audit analysts) is rejected.
_tier_a_note: Surya 2026-10-13: Simplify handles Workday, iCIMS and Oracle well enough; the agent autofills with Simplify and fills the rest by hand.
_less_aligned_note: Surya 2026-10-22: a role less aligned with his preferences (role_fit not 'aligned') is not applied to when its employer already holds 6 of his active, non-rejected positions (applications sent, jobs under way, and the queue when queueing). goat/caps.py.

application_caps._source: Waymo careers: at most 5 applications per 60 days
Harvey (Ashby): at most 4 applications per 30 days
Scale AI: 90 days before reapplying to the same role

_hardware_note: Surya 2026-10-18: apply to EE/CE 'or related' postings whose work is software; not to straight hardware roles. Titles that look like hardware wait for his call; the agent judges the rest from the posting.
off_role_title_pattern: \b(mechanical|civil|chemical|electrical|wireless|rf|manufacturing|process engineer\w*|tapeout|product (owner|manag\w*)|marketing|sales|human resources|people services|recruit\w*|accounting|reimbursement|brokerage|supply chain|business operations|operations analyst|financial analyst|legal|procurement|quality assurance technician)\b
_role_note: Surya 2026-10-21: SWE, SDE, application development, programming, technology, data science, data engineering and data analytics roles go first in the queue (aligned_title_pattern). A title that only names another field (off_role_title_pattern) waits as 'unsure' for his call.
